subject: Upcoming company event: Summer BBQ!
body: Dear team members, We are excited to announce our upcoming company event - a Summer BBQ! Join us for a fun-filled day of food, games, and team bonding. The event will be held at the company's rooftop garden on Friday, July 30th from 12 PM to 4 PM. Please RSVP by July 15th to confirm your attendance. We look forward to seeing you all there! Best regards, [Your Name]
